connector.name: Gmc MCP
connector.registryDescription: MIT-licensed pip-installable MCP for Google Merchant Center on Merchant API v1 (126 tools).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package gmc-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the kiwoongeom account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GMC_ACCOUNT_ID
env.description: Your 10-digit Google Merchant Center account ID (top-right of merchants.google.com).

env.name: GMC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY
env.description: Absolute path to a Google Cloud service-account JSON key file. The service account must be added as Admin in Merchant Center.

env.name: GMC_OAUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Absolute path to an OAuth user-token JSON file produced by `gmc-mcp auth-init`. Use this OR GMC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.

env.name: GMC_SUBACCOUNT_ID
env.description: Optional sub-account ID when operating an MCA (Multi-Client Account).

env.name: GMC_DRY_RUN
env.description: When 'true', writes are logged to the audit log only (no actual API calls).

env.name: GMC_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log verbosity: DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR.
